name: link-unfurl-check
title: Link Unfurl Check
description: Link field that previews the unfurl (title, description, image from your Open Graph fetch) and catches localhost and staging URLs, tracking parameters, redirects (hard when they land on a sign-in page) and missing or undersized images, with fixes.

meta.summary: Previews how a link will unfurl before you post it and catches localhost or staging links, tracking parameters and broken preview images.
catches: localhost and staging URLs, with a swap to publicOrigin
Redirects, especially to a sign-in page
limits: Needs your server-side fetchPreview; browsers can't fetch most pages cross-origin
Each platform renders previews a little differently and caches them
Doesn't check the page content itself
a11y: Visible label; input is described by the issues list
Issues are a polite live region with text, icons aria-hidden
Preview is a labelled section with aria-busy while loading
